primaryContract: PRD R4 §3 / §8.2 / §11 / §15.6; approved owner fulfillment workflow and sole native management client. Existing server capability, audited export and atomic dispatch/outbox remain authoritative.
interaction: Independent fulfillment capability entry. Filter paid orders, explicitly export up to 500, paste 1–25 tab-separated five-column rows copied from a spreadsheet, confirm actual dispatch, inspect per-row receipt. Does not claim XLSX file import.
recovery: Original batch key and rows retained for retry while page remains open. Hide clears sensitive drafts. If interrupted, read system facts before new batch; server uniqueness prevents duplicate shipment facts. No automatic replay or raw local PII persistence.
authority: Native signed member with commerce.fulfillment.manage; no dependency on commerce.order.read or PC sessions. Server remains final authority. Six-second foreground polling clears revoked access; every export/write rechecks server authorization.
privacy: Authenticated private temporary download, explicit PII notice, pre-open authority recheck and cleanup on hide/logout/cancellation. Operator-saved copies require approved retention policy.
